posts.text:
When Minneapolis Council Member LaTrisha Vetaw and I saw each other at a Prince celebration (where all good things happen), we ended up talking about how we could make the Camden railroad crossing safer. Frequent train blockages delay first responders, drivers, and pedestrians trying to get across.

That's why I’ve worked with Council Member Vetaw to secure federal funding to address the three at-grade rail crossings and make this area safer for everyone.
posts.summary: Advocates for safety improvements at Camden railroad crossing

Americans know that the cost of prescription drugs is too high. This week the Trump administration said it is cutting Medicare Part D, further increasing costs for seniors.

I fought to lower prescription drug costs as your Senator, and I’ll build on that work as your Governor by expanding state bulk purchasing of drugs and prioritizing lower-cost generics and biosimilars.

posts.text: Great to be in Red Wing for the River City Days Parade last weekend!

Wishing President Obama a very happy 65th birthday! 

Grateful for his continued leadership and service to our country.

David Rivkin helped create a sound that put Minnesota on the map and inspired generations of musicians around the world. From helping launch Prince's career to shaping the Minneapolis Sound, his influence on music is immeasurable. 

My thoughts are with his family, friends, and everyone whose lives he touched.

Red Wing was the place to be today for the River City Days Parade! So much fun to join Mayor Gary Iocco and everyone celebrating this incredible community. Thanks to everyone who came out and made it such a great day.

Marjorie Johnson spent decades bringing joy to kitchens across our state, earning more than 2,500 blue ribbons and inspiring generations of home bakers.

Now, the Minnesota State Fair is honoring her with the new Marjorie Johnson Honey Bee Award for the fair's best sweet rolls; a fitting tribute to a true Minnesota icon.
